Welcome to NEON RACE—an over-the-top futuristic machine learning race where competing teams push adaptive models to the limit.

In this visualization, each competitor tries to maximize accuracy while meeting strict energy budgets as the environment shifts in real time (cosmic storms, adversarial drift, and sudden dataset changes).

Watch the leaderboard surge, see strategies collide, and find out which team claims the Cosmic Edge.
